Good Morning Friends
In this video, we explore the *toughest hilly stretch of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor in Odisha,* located in the Koraput district.
This section is being constructed through *extreme terrain, deep valleys, elevated viaducts, & challenging mountain cuts,* making it one of the most difficult highway projects in the state.
In this ground report, you will see:
• Koraput Hilly Section Progress Update*
• Package-05 Major Pending Work Status*
• Elevated Highway & Viaduct Construction*
• Exit-14 (Koraput Exit) Interchange Update*
